text.body: <1> jagadvaicitryajananajāgarūkapadadvayam| aviyogarasābhijñamādyaṃ mithunamāśraye || 1 || samullāsarasākārāṃ tattvakairavakaumudīm| namāmi śāradāṃ devīṃ nāmarūpādhidevatām || 2 || uddāmaphaladāmurvīṃ gurvīmudadhimekhalām| bhaktibhūmipatiḥ śāsti śivapādābjaṣaṭpadaḥ || 3 || tasya putrasyāgamahāsamudrabirudāṅkitaḥ| somasūryakulottaṃso mahito manmabhūpatiḥ || 4 || sa kadācitsabhāmadhye kāvyālāpakathāntare| apṛcchadamṛtānandamādareṇa kavīśvaram || 5 || varṇaśuddhiṃ kāvyavṛttiṃ rasān bhāvānanantaram| netṛbhedānalaṅkārān doṣānapi ca tadguṇān || 6 || nāṭyadharmān rūpakoparūpakāṇāṃ bhidā api| cāṭuprabandhabhedāṃśca vikṣiptāṃstatra tatra tu || 7 || sañcityaikatra kathaya saukaryāya satāmiti| mayā tatprārthitenetthamamṛtānandayoginā || 8 || tantrāntaroditānarthān vākyānyeva kvacitkvacit| sañcitya kriyate samyak sarvālaṅkārasaṅgrahaḥ || 9 || akārādikṣakārāntā varṇāḥ syuḥ padatāṃ gatāḥ| padāni dvividhāni syuḥ suptiṅantavibhedataḥ || 10 || sañcayāṃstiṅsubantānāṃ vākyānyāhurvipaścitaḥ| tānyeva kaviklṛptāni sārthāni sarasāni ca || 11 || sālaṅkārāṇi nirdoṣāṇyāhuḥ kāvyaṃ vipaścitaḥ| padyaṃ gadyaṃ ca miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ kāvyamucyate || 12 || padyaṃ tu chandasā baddhaṃ gadyaṃ vākyakadambakam| padyagadyātmikaṃ miśraṃ nāṭakādikamucyate || 13 || sargabandhaṃ saṃskṛtena sāśvāsaṃ prākṛtena tu| tadvayaṃ ca mahākāvyaṃ seturāmāyaṇādikam || 14 || gadyaṃ tu gaditaṃ dvedhā kathā cākhyāyiketi ca| kathā kalpitavṛttāntā satyārthākhyāyikā matā || 15 || ucchvāsalambakādhyāyaṃ gadyate gadyayordvayoḥ| miśramaṅkādyupetaṃ syādbhāṣābhirbahubhiryutam || 16 || āśīrnamaskriyāvastunirdeśo vā'pi tanmukham| nagarārṇavaśailartucandrārkodayavarṇanaiḥ || 17 || udyānasalilakrīḍāmadhupānaratotsavaiḥ| vipralaṃbhairvivāhaiśca kumārodayavarṇanaiḥ || 18 || mantradyūtaprayāṇājināyakābhyudayairapi| alaṅkṛtamasaṅkṣiptaṃ rasabhāvanirantaram || 19 || caturvargaphalāyattaṃ caturodāttanāyakam| kāvyaṃ kalpāntarasthāyi kalpyate'nalpabhūtaye || 20 || chando yaratamairvyāptaṃ tathā bhajasanairapi| guruṇā laghunā vyāptā gaṇāstallakṣaṇaṃ yathā || 21 || ādimadhyāvasāneṣu yaratā yānti lāghavam| bhajasā gauravaṃ yānti manau tu gurulāghavau || 22 || varṇaṃ gaṇaṃ ca kāvyasya mukhe kuryātsuśobhanam| kartṛnāyakayostena kalyāṇamupajāyate || 23 || anyathāniṣṭasampattiranayoreva saṃbhavet| tadvarṇānāṃ gaṇānāṃ ca śuddhirjñeyā kramādyathā || 24 || ābhyāṃ bhavati samprītirmudībhyāṃ dhanamudvayāt| ṝbhyāṃ lūbhyāmapakhyātirecaḥ sukhakarā matāḥ || 25 || bindusargaṅañāḥ santi padādau na kadācana| caturbhyaḥ kādivarṇebhyo lakṣmīrapayaśastu cāt || 26| prītiḥ saukhyaṃ ca chānmitralābho jādbhayamṛtyukṛt| jhaṣṭaṭhābhyāṃ khedaduḥkhe śobhāśobhakarau ḍaḍhau || 27 || bhramaṇaṃ ṇātsukhaṃ tāttu thādyuddhaṃ sukhadau dadhau| naḥ pratāpī bhayāsaukhyamaraṇakleśadāhakṛt || 28 || pavargo yastu lakṣmīdo ro dāhī vyasanaṃ lavau| śaḥ sukhaṃ tanute ṣastu khedaṃ saḥ sukhadāyakaḥ || 29 || ho dāhakṛdvyasanado laḥ kṣaḥ sarvasamṛddhidaḥ| evaṃ pratyekataḥ proktaṃ varṇānāṃ vāstavaṃ phalam || 30 || saṃyogaḥ sarvathā tyājyo varṇānāṃ kṣaṃ vinā mukhe| śuddhamapyanyasaṃyuktamaśuddhamupajāyate || 31 || yathā madhu ghṛtonmiśraṃ viṣatāmeti vīryataḥ| gaṇānāṃ tu phalaṃ jñeyaṃ pratyekaṃ procyate yathā || 32 || yo vārirūpo dhanakṛt ro'gnirdāhabhayaṃkaraḥ| aiśvaryado nābhasasto bhaḥ saumyaḥ sukhadāyakaḥ || 33 || jaḥ sūryo rogadaḥ proktaḥ so vāyavyaḥ sukhapradaḥ| śubhado mo bhūmimayo no gaurdhanakaro mataḥ || 34 || devatāvācakāḥ śabdā ye ca bhadrādivācakāḥ| te sarve naiva nindyāḥ syurlipito gaṇato'pi vā || 35 || evaṃ varṇagaṇavyāptiḥ samānā gadyapadyayoḥ| saṃskṛte prākṛtādau ca vijñeyā vibudhottamaiḥ || 36 || evaṃ viniścitavinirmalavarṇavākyairhṛdyānavadyaracitairnavagadyapadyaiḥ| spūrtiṃ prayātu bhavato bhuvaneṣu kīrtiḥ kautūhalena viduṣāṃ komarāṅkabhīma || ityamṛtānandayogīndraviracite'laṅkārasaṅgrahe varṇagaṇavicāro nāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ || <2> evaṃ varṇagaṇavyāptivicāraṇavicakṣaṇaḥ| kavitvakārakastomasampannaḥ kavirucyate || 1 || rauciko vācikastvārthaḥ śilpako mārdavānugaḥ| vivekī bhūṣaṇārthī ca kavayaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || 2 || āvāpoddhārakṛdyānmanaso rucurātmanaḥ| rauciko vācikaḥ śaddhavāgāḍambarakārakaḥ || 3 || ārtho'bhidheyacitrārthī śilpako dvayacitrakṛt| śabdārthamārdavāpekṣī kaviḥ syānmārdavānugaḥ || 4 || śabdārthaguṇadoṣajño mahākavimatānugaḥ| śāstrālaṅkārasaṃskārī vivekī kavipuṅgavaḥ || 5 || alaṅkāraikaniṣṭho yo bhūṣaṇārthī budhairmataḥ| śaktirnidānaṃ kāvyasya kathyate kāvyavedibhiḥ || 6 || śabdacchando'bhidhānādiśāstralokāvalokanāt| naipuṇyaṃ kaviśikṣā ca tritayaṃ kāvyakāraṇam || 7 || na jātu jāyate kāvyaṃ yāṃ vinā kāraṇairapi| śabdacchando'bhidhānādyaiḥ sā śaktirabhidhīyate || 8 || jātamapyapahāsāya kalpate kavisantateḥ| śabdacchando'bhidhānānāṃ na vidhiḥ saṅgrahādiha || 9 || teṣāṃ svarūpamanyatra boddhavyaṃ buddhiśālibhiḥ| vākyānāṃ kaviklṛptānāmarthāḥ proktāścaturvidhāḥ || 10 || mukhyo lakṣyastathā gauṇo vyaṅgyaścetīha kathyate| sa mukhyaḥ kathitaḥ sākṣātsaṅketenābhidhīyate || 11 || jātikriyāguṇadravyabhedātso'pi caturvidhaḥ| gauścalo dhavalo ḍittha ityudāharaṇaṃ matam || 12|| vācyārthānupapattau yastatsambandhī pratīyate| prayojanavaśādanyo lakṣyo'rtho lakṣaṇā tridhā || 13 || vācyārthasya parityāgādanyo'rtho yatra lakṣyate| sā jahallakṣaṇā jñeyā gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityasau || 14 || vācyārthasyāparityāgādanyo'rtho yatra lakṣyate| ajahallakṣaṇā kuntāḥ praviśantīti sā matā || 15 || jahatī cāpyajahatī svārthaṃ yā tūbhayātmikā | sā chatriṇo vrajantīti tatrodāharaṇaṃ matam || 16 || ekeṇa chatriṇā'nyeṣāṃ chatritvamiha lakṣyate| sa gauṇo guṇasādṛśyādanyo'rtho yaḥ pratīyate || 17 || udāharaṇametasya siṃho māṇavako yathā| mukhyārthabādhe tadyogādvyaṅgyo lakṣyasya yatphalam || 18 || nāyaṃ mukhyo na vā lakṣyo lakṣaṇāyāḥ phalaṃ yataḥ| gaṅgā mukhyastaṭaṃ lakṣyo vyaṅgyaḥ śītalatādikam || 19 || anekavācakaḥ śabdo yatra vākye vyanakti tat| vyañjanaṃ tvabhidhāmūlaṃ saṃyogādibhirucyate || 20 || saṃyogo viprayogaśca sāhacaryaṃ virodhitā| arthaḥ prakaraṇaṃ liṅgaṃ śabdasyānyasya sannidhiḥ || 21 || sāmarthyamaucitī deśaḥ kālo vyaktiḥ svarādayaḥ| śabdārthasyānavacchede viśeṣasmṛtihetavaḥ || 22 || savajro harirityastrayogādindraḥ pratīyate| avajro harirityastraviyogādapi vāsavaḥ || 23 || sāhacaryāddāśarathī rāmalakṣmaṇayoriti| rāmo'rjunavirodhīti virodhādbhārgavo mataḥ || 24 || sthāṇuṃ bhaja jagadvandyamityarthe na śivo mataḥ| yuṣmadarthe prakaraṇāddevo jānāti māmiti || 25 || kanturmīnadhvaja iti liṅgātkāmaḥ pratīyate| devaḥ purārirityatra śabdasannidhitaḥ śive || 26 || mattaḥ piko dhvanatyatra sāmarthyātsurabhāvṛtau| aucityātpātu vaḥ śambhuriti sāmmukhyamiṣyate || 27 || atra devo rājatīti deśādrājā'vagamyate| citrabhānurvibhātīti kālenārtho'vasīyate || 28 || rātrau cedanalo jñeyo divā cettigmadīdhitiḥ| mitraṃ vibhāti tu suhṛnmitro bhātīti bhāskaraḥ || 29 || puṃnapuṃsakayorvyaktyā vyajyete tau yathākramam || svareṇa vyaktirarthasya vede kāvyeṣu na kvacit || 30 || etāvanmātranetre te ceṣṭayā'rtho vibhāvyate| arthāśca vyañjakāstatra sahakāritayā matāḥ || 31 || nilīyamānairvihagairnimīladbhiśca paṅkajaiḥ| vikasantyā ca mālatyā gato'staṃ jñāyate raviḥ || 32 || vaktā'tra yajamānaścetkālo homasya gamyate| viṭaścedatra boddhavyo veśyābhigamanodyame || 33 || capale locane nālaṃ manaścālayituṃ mama| ityarthavyaktiretasmin kākvā vākye'vasīyate || 34 || ityādi teṣāṃ vistāraḥ saṅgrahādiha nocyate| diṅmātraṃ darśitaṃ prājñairanuktamavagamyatām || 35 || vividhavihitavākyavṛttibhedaiḥ kavivarakalpitanavyakāvyabandhaiḥ| prabhavatu bhavataḥ pratāpabhānuḥ paramaniraṅkuśanūtnasāhasāṅka || 36 || ityamṛtānandayogīndraviracite'laṅkārasaṅgrahe śabdārthanirṇayo nāma dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ || <3> ātmano manasā yoge manasastvindriyaiḥ saha| indriyāṇāṃ tattadarthairiti jñānodayakramaḥ || 1 || jñāyamānairvibhāvādyairvyaktaḥ sthāyī rasaḥ smṛtaḥ| bhāvastu manasovṛttibhedaḥ sthairyamupeyivān || 2 || ratirhāsastathā śokaḥ krodhotsāhau bhayaṃ tathā| jugupsāvismayaśamāḥ sthāyībhāvā nava kramāt || 3 || śṛṅgārahāsyakaruṇā raudravīrabhayānakāḥ| bībhatsādbhutaśāntākhyā rasabhedā nava kramāt || 4 || poṣyamāṇā ratirbhāvaiḥ śṛṅgāra iti gīyate| evameva sthāyino'nye rasatāṃ prāpnuvanti hi || 5 || navanītaṃ yathā pākādghṛtatvaṃ pratipadyate| śrūyamāṇairvibhāvādyaiḥ kāvyeṣu rasasambhavaḥ || 6 || dṛśyamānaiḥ sadasyānāṃ nāṭakeṣu rasodayaḥ| vibhāvā anubhāvāśca sātvikā vyabhicāriṇaḥ || 7 || śrotṝṇāṃ prekṣakāṇāṃ ca te sarve rasapoṣakāḥ| ālambanatvenoddīpanatvena dvividhā matāḥ || 8 || vibhāvādyairviśeṣeṇa rasavyaktistu bhāvyate| ālambanavibhāvaḥ sa yamālambya rasodayaḥ || 9 || uddīpyate raso yaiste bhāvairuddīpanā matāḥ| utpanno yai raso bhāvairbhāvakairanubhūyate || 10 || te'nubhāvāḥ prakīrtyante vibhāvā aṅgasambhavāḥ| sattvaṃ nāma manovṛttiḥ sātvikāstatsamudbhavāḥ || 11 || stambhaḥ svedo'tha romāñcalayau vaisvaryavepathū| aśruvaivarṇyamityaṣṭau bhāvāḥ proktā manīṣibhiḥ || 12 || bhāve sthāyinyanaikāntyāccaranto vyabhicāriṇaḥ| utpadyante vilīyante vāridhāviva vīcayaḥ || 13 || nirvedaglāniśaṅkāśramadhṛtijaḍatāharṣadainyogracintā trāsorṣyāmarṣagarvasmṛtimaraṇamadāḥ suptinidrāvabodhāḥ| vrīḍāpasmāramohāḥ samatiralasatā vegatarkāvahitthā vyādhyunmādau viṣādotsukacapalayutā triṃśadete trayaśca || 14 || naṭeṣu rasabhāvānāmālokyatvānna tattvataḥ| rasaḥ sāmājikeṣveva svasvabhāvarasasmṛteḥ || 15 || prāṇināmapi sarveṣāṃ loke svābhāviko rasaḥ| anyonyālambanatvaṃ syātkāntākāmukayo rase || 16 || uddīpanāḥ syuḥ śṛṅgāre candrikopavanādayaḥ| anubhāvāḥ prakīrtyante kaṭākṣakṣepaṇādayaḥ || 17 || stambhādayaḥ sātvikāḥ syurdarśanasparśanādiṣu| nirvedādyā yathāyogyaṃ yojyāḥ sañcāriṇo'pi ca || 18 || sambhogo viprayogaśca śṛṅgāro dvividho mataḥ| sambhogaḥ sannikarṣaḥ syādbhāṣaṇādyairmitho yathā || 19 || vrīḍākātaralocanaṃ vinamitaṃ vaktraṃ viśadvepathū hastau hallakasodarau pulakitau spṛṣṭau tavemau stanau| tanvī tārakitā tanustanutaraiḥ svedāmbhasāṃ jālakaiḥ bhāvo bhāvajarājyalakṣmividito bāhyairalaṃ ḍambaraiḥ || " vipralambho'bhilāṣerṣyāpravāsādyairanekadhā| udāharaṇameteṣāmaṣṭāvasthāsu vakṣyate || 20 || ratyullāsasamudbhūtā vidyante'tra daśā daśa| cakṣuḥprītirmanassaktiḥ saṅkalpo jāgarastathā || 21 || tanutā viṣayadveṣaḥ trapānāśastataḥ param| moho mūrchā mṛtiriti vijñeyāḥ prathamā yathā || 22 || ādarādīkṣaṇaṃ yacca cakṣuḥprītiḥ praśasyate| "sāmiprapullasarasīruhakoṇaniryanmattadvirephamahilāgatigarvacoraiḥ| lajjālasairlalitabhāvaśataiḥ kaṭākṣaiḥ sā tvāmavaikṣata sakhī mama manvabhūpa || " cittāsaktirmuhuścintā pratikṛtyādibhiryathā || 23 || "tvāṃ manvabhūpa likhituṃ trapayāsamarthā sā sannidhau mama cirādalikhadvicintya| padmadvayaṃ karikarau gaganaṃ kavāṭaṃ sambhoruhaṃ yugayugaṃ śaśinaṃ tataśca || " manorathaiḥ priyavyāptiḥ saṅkalpaḥ kathito yathā| "āmīlitākṣamalakākulaphālabhāgamāsvinnagaṇḍamadharasphuraṇābhirāmam| pāṇau nidhāya vadanaṃ parabhāgaśālimanmakṣitīśa ratimeti manorathaiḥ sā || " priyānavāptyā taccintāsātatyājjāgaro yathā || 24 || "rākāvidhorapi raveraviśeṣatoṣā sā jāgarādapi sakhī mama manmabhūpa| jānāti nāntaramananyajabāṇajālaiḥ dīnā niśādivasayordinanāthavaṃśa || " tadalābhāttanoḥ kāmajvareṇa tanutā yathā| "bhakteśanandana! bhavadvirahe mṛgākṣī manmakṣitīśa madanajvarakarśitāṅgī| labdhuṃ tvadīyahṛdaye lalite'vakāśaṃ kārśyaṃ nijaṃ kalayate kamanīyameva || " arthāntarāsahiṣṣuṇutvaṃ viṣayadveṣaṇaṃ yathā || 25 || "ālāpamālinikarasya niśamya bhītā mugdhā vilokya vadanaṃ mukuraṃ jahāti| mandaṃ na niśvasiti manmathavedanārtā kīrendu māruta bhayāt kimu manmabhūpa || " mānatyāgastrapānāśo gauravāgaṇanādyathā| "mandā vahanti malayācalagandhavāhāḥ mattā nadanti makarandarasena bhṛṅgāḥ| mānaṃ jahāti madanāśugapātabhītā manmakṣitīśa bhajate na marālayānam || " unmādaścittavaikalyānmoha ityucyate yathā || 26 || "ālolapallavavatīmavalambya śākhāmāgamyatāmiti śanairanunīya cūtam || " netrāmbu sā tyajati netumapārayantī kopena manmanṛpate komarāṅkabhīma || " muhurundriyavaikalyānmūrchā jñānakṣayo yathā| "mugdhā muhuḥ pihitamanmathabāṇapīḍāṃ mūrchāṃ sakhī mṛgayate mama manmabhūpa| ājñātavedanaviśeṣatayā vivekaṃ nāṅgīkaroti nayane vinimīlayantī || " kṣaṇāntare prāṇahāniḥ priyālābhānmṛtiryathā || 27 || "puṇyaṃ purātanamihāsti yadi tvadīyamaṅkaṃ viśaṅkamādhiroḍhumarālakeśyāḥ| kāmo nayenna daśamīmiyatāpyavasthāṃ kālena manmanṛpate karuṇāparaktām || " hāsa eva vibhāvādyaiḥ puṣṭo hāsyatvamāgataḥ| vidūṣakādirālambo bhāvo hāsyaraso yathā || 28 || "sammārjanīsatatasaṅgamanārapūtaṃ pāṇiṃ pavitrikace bahutīrthatoyaiḥ| manmastake'rpitavatī madhupānamattā dhiktasya mānamiha kintu vimānanāya || " uddīpanavibhāvāḥ syustadbhāvākāravikriyāḥ| bhāvakākṣivikāsādyāḥ anubhāvāḥ prakīrttitāḥ || 29 || aśruvaivarṇyavaisvaryapramukhāḥ sāttvikāḥ smṛtāḥ| atra hāsāśrumatyādibhāvāḥ sañcāriṇo matāḥ || 30 || uttamādivibhedena tridhā hāsyaraso mataḥ| smitaṃ ca hasitaṃ cetāvanubhāvāvihottame || 31 || ādyaṃ vikāsigaṇḍaṃ syādīṣallakṣyaradaṃ param| madhyamaṃ syādvihasitaṃ tathopahasitaṃ param || 32 || mṛdusvanaṃ syātprathamaṃ śiraḥkampaṃ paraṃ matam| adhame cāpahasitaṃ tathā'tihasitaṃ matam || 33 || śiraḥkampāśrumatpūrvaṃ vikṣiptāṅgaṃ dvitīyakam| śoka eva vibhāvādyaiḥ puṣṭaḥ karuṇatāṃ gataḥ || 34 || iṣṭanāśādaniṣṭāpteḥ karuṇo'pi dvidhā mataḥ| naṣṭo vāniṣṭayukto vā bandhurālambanaṃ yathā || 35 || "kastavādya kathamarpayetsudhāṃ nātha naṣṭanayano'si sāmpratam| hanta vītakaruṇo haṭhātkathaṃ yaṣṭimandhavidhṛtāṃ yamo'harat || " "nṛpatitanayabhṛtyairnīyamāno nṛśaṃsaiḥ pathijanavati paścātpāśabaddhasvabāhuḥ| niśamayata virāgānnīyate'sau nihantuṃ kamalajakulajātaḥ kairavaḥ kātarātmā || " uddīpanavibhāvāḥ syuḥ svajanākrandanādayaḥ| anubhāvāstu niśvāsavilāparuditādayaḥ || 36|| stambhāśrupātavaisvaryapramukhāḥ sāttvikāḥ sphuṭāḥ | atrāpasmāradīnatvamaraṇālasyasambhramāḥ || 37 || viṣādajaḍatonmādacintādyā vyabhicāriṇaḥ| krodha eva vibhāvādyaiḥ puṣṭo raudratvamāptavān || 38 || mātsaryādapi ca dveṣādraudro'pi dvividho yathā| "ājanmabrahmacārī pṛthulabhujaśilāstambhavibhrājamānajyāghātaśreṇirekhāntaritavasumatī cakrajaitrapraśastiḥ| vakṣaḥpīṭhe dhanāstravraṇakiṇakaṭhine guhyakeśānāṃ kathaṃ te pelavaṃ vanam || " sandhāvaślīlatvaṃ doṣo'tra vivekaśālibhirjñeyaḥ || 31 || "urvyasāvatra tarvālī sarvartau cārvavasthitiḥ| nātra prayujyate gantuṃ śiro namaya tanmanāk || " iha kaṣṭatvaṃ sandheḥ kliṣṭatayā kathyate sakṛddoṣaḥ| ayathātvaṃ gurulaghvoḥ varṇānāṃ yatra hīnatādhikye || 32 || bhagnacchandovākyaṃ hatavṛttaṃ ceti tadvadanti yathā| "kāmena pañcāpi bāṇā vimuktā mṛgekṣaṇāsvityayathāgurutvam| madanabāṇāḥ niśitāḥ patanti vāmekṣaṇāsvityayathālaghutvam || " indupādāḥ śiśirāḥ spṛśantītyūnavarṇatā| sa kārasya kisalayānnyārdrāṇītyādhikākṣaram || 33 || pādānte madhye vā yatirvirāmo'sya bhagnatātra yathā| "ādityasya mahati vaṃśe jāto nṛpatireṣa dhanakīrtiḥ| bhūridayālaṅkāraḥ prabhūtaguṇavatsalo jayatyavanau || " yena vinā yadvākyaṃ nyūnaṃ tannyūnapadamuśanti yathā || 34 || "tathābhūtāṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpasadasi pāñcālanayā vane vyādhaiḥ sārdhaṃ suciramuṣitaṃ valkaladharaiḥ| virāṭasyāvāse sthitamanucitārambhanibhṛtaṃ guru khedaṃ khinne mayi bhajati nādyāpi kuruṣu || " asmābhiriti viśeṣyābhāvādiha vākyamabhihitaṃ nyūnam| yadabhāvādapi pūrṇaṃ vākyaṃ tenādhikapadamatra yathā || 35 || "sphuṭikākṛtinirmalaḥ prakāmaṃ pratisaṅkrāntaniśātaśāstratattvaḥ| aviruddhasamanvitoktiyuktiḥ| pratimallāstamayodayaḥ sa ko'pi || " ākṛtipadena vākyaṃ vināpi sampūrṇameva bhavatīha| kathitapadaṃ yadyasmin padasya kathitasya kathanameva yathā || 36 || "adhikataralatalpaṃ kalpitasvāpalīlā parimilananimīlatpāṇḍimā gaṇḍapālī| sutanu! kathaya kasya vyañjayatyañjasaiva smaranarapatilīlāyauvarājyābhiṣekam || " līleti pūrvakathitaṃ punarapi līleti kathitametasmin| yasminnadhaḥ prakṛṣṭaṃ patatprakarṣaṃ tadāmananti yathā || 37 || "kaḥ kaḥ kutra narghurghurāyitaghurī ghoro ghuretsūkaraḥ kaḥ kaḥ kaṃ kamalākaraṃ vikamalaṃ kartuṃ karī nodyataḥ| ke ke kāni vanānyaraṇyamahiṣā nonmūlayeyuryataḥ siṃhīsnehavilāsabaddhavasatiḥ pañcānano vartate || " atra kariṇaḥ prakṛṣṭānmahiṣāṇāmuparikīrtanaṃ kurute| punarapi samāpya kathitaṃ samāptapunarāttamiti vadanti yathā || 38 || "kreṅkāraḥ smarakārmukasya suratakrīḍāpikānāṃ ravaḥ jhaṅkāro ratimañjarīmadhulihāṃ līlācakorīdhvaniḥ| tanvyāḥ kañculikāpasāraṇabhujākṣepaskhalatkaṅkaṇa kvāṇaḥ prema tanotu vo navavayolāsyāya veṇusvanaḥ || " atra samāpto'pyarthaḥ punarapyādīyate'ntyapādāntye| arthāntaraikavācakamaparārthagataikavācakaṃ tu yathā || 39 || "masṛṇacaraṇapātaṃ gamyatāṃ bhūḥ sadarbhā viracaya sicayāntaṃ mūrdhni dharmaḥ kaṭhoraḥ| taditi janakaputrī locanairaśrupūrṇaiḥ pathi pathikavadhūbhirvīkṣitā śikṣitā ca || " iha tacchabdo hetuḥ sicayāntaṃ mūrdhni viracayetyatra| abhavanmatayogaṃ tadyatra samāse padaṃ guṇībhūtam || 40 || nānyaiḥ pradhānabhūtairlabhate yogaṃ prayojanāya yathā| "?Bcatvāro vayamṛtvijaḥ sa bhagavān karmopadeṣṭā hariḥ saṅgrāmādhvaradīkṣito narapatiḥ patnī gṛhītavratā| kauravyāḥ paśavaḥ priyāparibhavakleśopaśāntiḥ phalaṃ rājanyopanimantraṇāya rasati sphītaṃ yaśo dundubhiḥ || " saṅgrāmādhvaraśabdaḥ samāsago doṣabhāvametyatra || 41 || anabhihitavācyametadyatra na vaktavyamabhyadhāyi yathā| "tvayi nisargarateḥ priyavādinaḥ praṇayabhaṅgaparāṅmukhacetasaḥ| kamaparādhalavaṃ mama paśyasi tyajasi mānini! dāsajanaṃ yataḥ || " atrāvaśyaṃ vācyaṃ paśyasyaparādhalavamapīti padam || 42 || asthānasthapadaṃ tadyatrāsthāne sthitaṃ padaṃ hi yathā| "lagnaḥ kelikacagrahaślathajaṭālambena nidrāntare mudrāṅkaḥ śitikandharenduśakalenāntaḥ kapolasthalam| pārvatyā nakhalakṣmaśaṅkitasakhīnarmasmitahrītayā pronmṛṣṭaḥ karapallavena kuṭilā tāmracchaviḥ pātu vaḥ || " kuṭilātāmracchaviriti nakhalakṣmetyāditaḥ purā vācyam || 43 || asthānasthasamāsaṃ yatrāsthāne samāsaśāli yathā| "adyāpi stanaśailadurgaviṣame sīmantinīnāṃ hṛdi sthātuṃ vāñchati māna eṣa dhigiti krodhādivālohitaḥ| prodyaddūrataraprasāritakaraḥ karṣatyasau tatkṣaṇāt phullatkairavakośanissaradaliśreṇīkṛpāṇaṃ śaśi || " kruddhoktāvatra kṛto na samāsaḥ kintu kavivacasyeva || 44 || saṅkīrṇaṃ yatretaravākyapadānītaratra santi yathā| "kimiti na paśyasi kopaṃ pādagataṃ bahuguṇaṃ gṛhāṇemam| nanu muñca hṛdayanāthaṃ kaṇṭhe manasastamorūpam || " adhikaspuṭamitaretaravākyapadānāṃ mithaḥ praveśo'tra || 45 || kliṣṭatvamekavākye vākyabahutve tu bhavati saṅkīrṇam| garbhitamitaradvākyaṃ vākyasyaikasya yatra madhye'sti || 46 || "parāpakāraniratairdurjanaiḥ saha saṅgatiḥ| vadāmi bhavatastattvaṃ na vidheyā kadācana || " vākyamidamitaravākye sthitamiha bhavato vadāmi tattvamiti| yatra prasiddhihīnaṃ prasiddhiyutamucyate padaṃ tu yathā || 47 || "mahāpralayamārutakṣubhitapuṣkalāvartakapracaṇḍaghanagarjitapratirutānukārī muhuḥ| ravaḥ śravaṇabhairavaḥ sthagitarodasīkandaraḥ kṛto'dya samarodadherayamabhūtapūrvakramaḥ || " rava iti śabdaviśeṣaṇaṃ śabdamātre prasiddhibhāgbhavati| bhagnaprakramamuktaṃ yatra prakrāntarūpabhaṅgaḥ syāt || 48 || tadanekadhā vibhedaiḥ prakṛtipratyayamukhaiḥ krameṇa yathā| "nāthe niśāyā niyaterniyogādastaṃ gate hanta niśāpi yātā| kulāṅganānāṃ hi daśānurūpaṃ nātaḥ paraṃ bhadrataraṃ kimasti || " gata iti tu prakrānte yāteti prakṛtiratra bhaṅgavatī || 49 || "yaśo'dhigantuṃ sukhalipsayā vā manuṣyasaṅkhyāmativartituṃ vā| nirutsukānāmabhiyogabhājāṃ samutsukevāṅkamupaiti siddhiḥ || " atra sukhalipsayeti pratyayabhaṅgo vivicya vijñeyaḥ| anye'pyatra jñeyāḥ pratyayabhaṅgā na tu prapañcyante || 50 || yatra vihitaḥ kramaḥ syādakramamiti vākyamāmananti yathā| "nirmāṇasthitisaṃhārahetavo jagatāṃ matāḥ| viṣṇustrilocanāmbhojayonayaḥ pālayantu vaḥ || " parameṣṭhihariharā iti vācye bhagraḥ kramo bhavatyatra || 51 || amatapadārthaṃ yatra prakṛtaviruddhārthakathanameva yathā| "rāmamanmathaśareṇa tāḍitā dussahena hṛdaye niśācarī| gandhavadrudhiracandanokṣitā jīviteśavasatiṃ jagāma sā || " prakṛtarase'tra viruddhaṃ śṛṅgārarasasya varṇanaṃ vihitam || 52 || yatra raso'sti na vākye rasacyutaṃ taditi kīrtayanti yathā| "ekapucchaścatuṣpādaḥ kakudmān lambakambalaḥ| gorapatyaṃ balīvardo ghāsamatti sukhena saḥ || " jātirapi nīrasattvānnālaṅkāro'sya kiṃ tu doṣatvam || 53 || aprastutārthametadyatnāprastutanutiḥ karoti yathā| "tamālaśyāmalaṃ kṣāramatyacchamatiphenilam| pādena laṅghayāmāsa hanūmāneṣa sāgaram || " nātra śyāmalatādeḥ kathanaṃ tatropayogi syāt || 54 || artho'puṣṭaḥ kaṣṭo vyāhatapunaruktaduṣkramagrāmyāḥ| sandigdho nirhetuḥ prasiddhividyāviruddhaśca || 55 || vyarthīkṛtaḥ saniyamā niyamaviśeṣāviśeṣaparivṛttāḥ| sākāṅkṣoktaviruddhoddhatyapunaḥ svīkṛto'ślīlaḥ || vidhyanuvādanivṛttaḥ sahacarabhinno'rthadoṣāḥ syuḥ || 56 || viśeṣaṇānāmuktānāṃ phalaṃ yatra na vidyate| viśeṣyapoṣakatvena so'puṣṭārtho mato yathā || 57 || "ativitatagaganasaraṇiprasaraṇaparimuktaviśramānandaḥ| marudullāsitasaurabhakamalākarahāsakṛdravirjayati || " vimuktaviśramānandau puṣyato na raverjayam| kaṣṭaḥ kṛcchreṇa vijñeyaḥ śabdasaṅkṣepato yathā || 58 || "kalaśe nijahetudaṇḍajaḥ kimu cakrabhramakāritā guṇaḥ| sa taduccakucau bhavan prabhājharacakrabhramamātanoti yat || " atyantavyavadhānena jñāyate'rtho'tra no haṭhāt| anādṛtasyaivotkarṣo vākye syādvyāhato yathā || 59 || "jagati jayinaste te bhāvā navendukalādayaḥ prakṛtimadhurāḥ santyevānye mano madayanti ye| mama tu yadiyaṃ yātā loke vilocanacandrikā nayanaviṣayaṃ janmanyekaḥ sa eva mahotsavaḥ || " anādṛtyendurekhādyaṃ ślāghyate candrikātviha| eka eva dvirukto'rthaḥ punarukto mato yathā || 60 || "astrajvālāvalīḍhapratibalajaladherantaraurvāyamāṇe senānāthe sthite'smin mama pitari gurau sarvadhanvīśvarāṇām| karṇālaṃ sambhrameṇa! vraja kṛpa! samaraṃ muñca hārdikyaśaṅkāṃ tāte cāpadvitīye vahati raṇadhurāṃ ko bhayasyāvakāśaḥ || " paunaruktyamihārthasya prasiddhaṃ samapādayoḥ| vaktavyayorarthayoryo vyutkramo duṣkramo yathā || 61 || "bhūpālaratna! nirdainyapradānaprathitotsava !| viśrāṇaya turaṅgaṃ me mātaṅgaṃ vā madālasam || " mātaṅgasyātra nirdeśo nyāyyaḥ prāgeva budhyatām| nirlajjaiḥ kathito yo'rtho grāmyosāvucyate yathā || 62 || "sapaṅkatalavinyastasāraṅgakhurasannibham| āromaśaṃ mṛgākṣīṇāṃ vande madanamandiram || " iha grāmyatvamarthasya prasiddhamavagamyate| dvedhā pratīyamāno'rthaḥ sandigdho'nirṇayādyathā || 63 || "mātsaryamutsārya vicārya kāryamāryāḥ samaryādamidaṃ vadantu| sevyā nitambāḥ kimu bhūdharāṇāmuta smarasmeravilāsinīnām || " virakto vātra rakto vā vaktā cennirṇayo bhavet| nirhetuko vinā hetuṃ kāryaṃ yatrocyate yathā || 64 || "gṛhītaṃ yenāsīḥ parībhavabhayānnocitamapi prabhāvādyasyābhūnna khalu tava kaścinna viṣayaḥ| parityaktaṃ tena tvamasi sutaśokānna tu bhayādvimokṣye śastra! tvāmahamapi yataḥ svasti bhavate || " vimokṣye'hamapītyatra na hetuḥ śastramocane! sa prasiddhiviruddho yo lokairavidito yathā || 65 || "idaṃ te kenoktaṃ kathaya kamalātaṅkavadane yadetasmin hemnaḥ kaṭikamiti dhatse khalu dhiyam| idaṃ taddussādhākramaṇaparamāstraṃ smṛtibhuvā tava prītyā cakraṃ karakamalamūle vinihitam || " cakraṃ manobhavasyāstramaprasiddhamihocyate| vidyāviruddhaḥ smṛtyādivirodhātkathito yathā || 66 || "sadā snātvā niśīthinyāṃ sakalaṃ vāsaraṃ budhaḥ| nānāvidhāni śāstrāṇi vyācaṣṭe ca śruṇoti ca || uparāgaṃ vinā rātrau snānaṃ tu śrutigarhitam| vyarthīkṛto yacchlāghyānāṃ vyarthatvāpādanaṃ yathā || 67 || "prāptāḥ śriyaḥ sakalakāmadughāstataḥ kiṃ nyastaṃ padaṃ śirasi vidviṣatāṃ tataḥ kim| santarpitāḥ praṇayino vibhavaistataḥ kiṃ kalpaṃ sthitaṃ tanubhṛtāṃ tanubhistataḥ kim || " atra vyarthatvamevoktamarthānāṃ na prayojanam| niyamo'nucite'rthe yaḥ sa syātsaniyamo yathā || 68 || "kaṭu raṭati nikaṭavartī vācāṭaṣṭiṭṭibho yatra| apasaraṇameva śaraṇaṃ maunaṃ vā rājahaṃsasya || " atrāpasaraṇe yukto niyamenaivakārataḥ maunaṃ vetyanyapakṣasya sambhavāddūṣaṇaṃ hi yat || 69 || niyame sati vaktavye tattyāgo'niyamo yathā| "caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām| hatānyekena rāmeṇa mānuṣeṇa padātinā || " ekenaiveti vaktavye naivātra niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ || 70 || vācye viśeṣe sāmānyādviśeṣavyatyayo yathā| "śyāmāṃ śyāmalimānamānayata bhoḥ sāndrairmaṣīkūrcakairmantraṃ tantramatha prayujya harata śvetotpalānāṃ śriyam| candraṃ cūrṇayata kṣaṇācca kaṇaśaḥ kṛtvā śilāpaṭṭake yena draṣṭumahaṃ kṣame daśadiśastadvaktramudrāṅkitāḥ || " atra jyotsnāmiti śyāmā viśeṣoktirhi yujyate || 71 || sāmānyoktau viśeṣoktiḥ sāmānyavyatyayo yathā| "kallolavellitadṛṣatparuṣaprahārai ratnānyamūni makarālaya! māvamaṃsthāḥ! kiṃ kaustubhena vihito bhavato na nāma yācñāprasāritakaraḥ puruṣottamo'pi || " ratnasāmānyato nāma sindhoratra na kaustubhāt || 72 || yatra bāhyārthasāpekṣaḥ sākāṅkṣo gīyate yathā| "dvāraṃ dvāramitā vṛṣṭiḥ śītavātādiduḥsahā| diśo nīrandhratimiranigīrṇā iva niṣprabhāḥ || " ākāṅkṣate'tra bāhyārthaṃ tvarayotpāṭyatāmiti || 73 || sa syāduktiviruddho'rtho virodhastvarthayoryathā| "na svargo nāpi narako dharmādharmau na tatphale | dhanyo'si yastvaṃ sarvasvaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchasi || " paralokādyabhāvokterviruddhaṃ dānakīrtanam || 74 || tyakte'pi punarupāttastyaktapunaḥ svīkṛto mataḥ sa yathā| "are! rāmāhastābharaṇa! bhasalaśreṇiśaraṇa! smarakrīḍāvrīḍāśamana! virahiprāṇadamana!| sarohaṃsottaṃsa! pracaladalanīlotpalasakhe! sakhedo'haṃ mohaṃ ślathaya kathaya kvenduvadanā || " virahidamaneti muktvā svīkurute sakhipadena punareva || 75 || aślīlo mukhyārthādanyo vrīḍākaro mataḥ sa yathā| "hantumeva pravṛttasya stabdhasya vivaraiṣiṇaḥ| yathā'sya jāyate pāto na tathā punarunnatiḥ || " atra dhvanyo mukhyādanyārtho jñāyate hi lajjāyai || 76 || vidhyanuvādavivṛtto vidhyanuvādau vivartitau sa yathā| "prayatnaparibodhitaḥ stutibhiradya śeṣe niśāmakeśavamapāṇḍavaṃ bhuvanamadya nissomakam| iyaṃ parisamāpyate raṇakathādya doḥśālināmapaitu ripukānanātigururadya bhāro bhuvaḥ || " śayitaḥ paribodhya sa iti vaktavyamihānuvādavidhiyugalam || 77 || sahotkṛṣṭairnikṛṣṭoktirbhinnaṃ sahacarairyathā| "śrutena buddhirvyasanena mūrkhatā madena nārī salilena nimnagā| niśā śaśāṅkena dhṛtiḥ samādhinā nayena cālaṅkriyate narendratā || " utkṛṣṭebhyaḥ śrutādibhyo bhinne vyasanamūrkhate || 78 || doṣā eva guṇībhāvaṃ prāpnuvanti kvacitkvacit| "so'dhyaiṣṭa vedāṃstridaśānayaṣṭa pitṝnatārṣsītsamamaṃsta bandhūn| vyajeṣṭa ṣaḍvargamaraṃsta nītau samūlaghātaṃ nyavadhīdarīṃśca || " udāharaṇakāvyatvānna duṣṭaṃ śrutikaṭvapi || 79 || prahelikādvyarthibandhaikākṣaradvyakṣarādiṣu| kliṣṭāsamarthaneyārthā vācakadyā na dūṣakāḥ || 80 || "devarājo mayā dṛṣṭo vārivāraṇamastake| adannarkaṃ ca somaṃ ca viṣaṃ pītvā kṣayaṃ gataḥ || " vārivāraṇaśabdo'tra neyārtho'pi na duṣyati| asamarthāvapi viṣakṣayau svārthe na duṣyataḥ || 81 || anyadapyevamevohyamudāharaṇadarśane| "balyarikratvarī pātāṃ sāmbuvyambughanopamau| sadṛśau bakakākābhyāṃ ca vai tu hi ca vai tu hi || " nirarthakaṃ na duṣṭaṃ syāddhāsyecchāndasabhāṣite || 82 || balyarikratvarītyatra kaṣṭasandhyapyadūṣaṇam| "kaṇḍūterapratīkārādantarliṅgavimardanāt| na dravanti na tṛpyanti yoṣito nīcamehane || " atra vrīḍā'ślīlamapi kāmatantre na dūṣaṇam || 83 || "uttānocchūnamaṇḍūkapāṭitodarasannibhe!| kledane srīvraṇe saktirakrimeḥ kasya jāyate || " jugupsāślīlamapyatra viraktoktau na dūṣaṇam| "pṛthukārtasvarapātraṃ bhūṣitaniḥśeṣaparijanaṃ deva!| vilasatkareṇugahanaṃ samprati samamāvayoḥ sadanam || " sandigdhamapyatrāduṣṭaṃ vaktṛboddhavyabhedataḥ || 84 || "grahaistataḥ pañcabhiruccasaṃsthitairasūryagaiḥ sūcitabhāgyasampadam| asūta putraṃ samaye śacīsamā trisādhanā śaktirivārthamakṣayam || " apratītamapi jyotiḥprasaṅge'tra na duṣyati| "mriyatāṃ mriyatāṃ tanvi! kiṃ vā jīvikayānayā| jīvitaṃ sakhi mānāya naiva cejjīvitena kim || " asminviṣaṇṇavacane paunaruktyaṃ guṇo mataḥ || 85 || "gāḍhāliṅganavāmanīkṛtakucaprodbhinnaromodgamā sāndrasreharasātirekavigalatkāñcīnitambāmbarā| mā mā mānada! mātimāmalamiti kṣāmākṣarollāpinī suptā kiṃ nu mṛtā nu kiṃ manali me līnā vilīnā nu kim" māmetyādi nyūnapadaṃ pāravaśye na dūṣaṇam| "yadvacca nāhitamatirbahucāṭugarbhaṃ kāryonmukhaḥ khalajanaḥ kṛtakaṃ bravīti| tatsādhavo na na vidanti kimucyate? chadmanānupraviśya sādhayāmo'bhilaṣitam|" tattvārthakathanaṃ yattanmārga ityucyate yathā || 42 || "maṅgalavatī nanu saurabha! kapaṭamiva kāyavantaṃ ka iva viṭacchadmanā khilāmenām| alamatisandhānamatastattvaṃ kathayāmi tāvato'rthasya || " savitarkaṃ tu yadvākyaṃ rūpaṃ tatkathyate yathā| "rājā vayasya! nādyāpi roṣaṃ muñcasi| vadhabandhādikathanaṃ vidravaḥ kathyate yathā || 52 || "kairavaḥ "baddhaḥ paścādbalibhiravanīpālabhṛtyairniyogādyasyāḥ krūrairyamaparisaraṃ prāpaṇīyo yathāsam| sā tvaṃ doṣaṃ mayi vitanuṣe sāmprataṃ sāmprataṃ te sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ viṣamiva khale sādhayetsādhu tena || " dravo gurutiraskārakathanaṃ kathyate yathā| "lavaḥ vṛddhāste na vicāraṇīyacaritāstiṣṭhantu huṃ vardhatāṃ sundasrīdamane'pyakhaṇḍayaśaso loke mahānto hi te| yāni trīṇyakutomukhānyapi padānyāsan kharāyodhane kiṃ vā kauśalamindrasūnunidhane tatrāpyabhijño janaḥ || " śaktiḥ saṅkīrtyate sā yadvirodhaśamanaṃ yathā || 53 || "rājā vayasya! visṛjya manasi roṣaṃ mā viruddhaṃ vaco me tava bhavatu nijānāmeva kopaprasādau| kharatararaviraśmivrātapāte'pi sadyaḥ sarasijanikurumbaṃ svairamunmeṣameti || " tarjanodvejane yatra sā dyutiḥ kīrtyate yathā| "kairavaḥ yā tvaṃ dūtī yamasyeva tadā tarjitavatyapi| saiva samprati sodvegā capale! cāru bhāṣase || " kīrtanaṃ gurunāmno yatprasaṅagaḥ kathyate yathā || 54 || "makaradaṃṣṭrā jādo jaladhijharādo kāsārādo viṇikkantaṃ| sumaradi ṇāgo hiae kiṃ paṃkālittakāsaraṃ jādu || (jāto jaladhijharāt kāsārādviniṣkrāntam| smarati nāgo hṛdaye kiṃ paṅkāliptakāsaraṃ jātu || ) yatrāvamānanaṃ vākye chalanaṃ tanmataṃ yathā| bandī deva! "ko'yaṃ te pratikartumatra bhavataścelāntabaddhākṣato bhūyaḥ svasti vadannaṭatyanugṛhaṃ dūrvārpaṇārtāṅguliḥ| kiṃ karṇāṭamahīpatiḥ! kimu mahārāṣṭrāḥ ! kimaṅgādhipaḥ! ki pāṇḍyaḥ! kimu ghūrjaraḥ! kimamunā sarve'pi te sevakāḥ || " svasāmarthyasya kathanaṃ vyavasāyo mato yathā || 55 || "kairavaḥ jaḍaṃ jalanidhervāri muktvā muninirākṛtam| mama svānte madhudhvaṃsī nityaṃ śete nirāmaye || ato'khilajagatsvahamevātulaprabhāvaḥ" virodhanaṃ svaśaktyuktiḥ saṃrabdhānāṃ mataṃ yathā| "arjunaḥ ārya! prasīda| kimatra krodhena? apriyāṇi karotyeṣa vācā śakto na karmaṇā| hatabhrātṛśato duḥkhī pralāpairasya kā vyathā || " "bhīmaḥ are, bharatakulendukalaṅka! adyaiva kiṃ na visṛjeyamahaṃ bhavantaṃ duḥśāsanānugamanāya kaṭupralāpin! vighnaṃ gururna kurute yadi madgadāgranirbhidyamānaraṇitāsthani te śarīre || " anyacca re mūḍha! "śokaṃ strīvannayanasalilairyatparityājito'si bhrāturvakṣaḥsthalavighaṭane yacca sākṣīkṛto'si| āsīdetattava kurupate! kāraṇaṃ jīvitasya kruddhe yuṣmatkulakamalinīkuñjare bhīmasena || rājā durātman! bharatakulāpasada! pāṇḍavapaśo! nāhaṃ bhavāniva vikatthanāpragalbhaḥ| kintu, drakṣyanti na cirātsuptaṃ bāndhavāstvāṃ raṇāṅgaṇe| madgadābhinnavakṣo'sthiveṇikābhīmabhūṣaṇam || " prarocanā siddhavadyadbhāvyarthakathanaṃ yathā || 56 || "bandī deva āste dvāri vadhūrvidhātṛracanāvaiduṣyavikrānti bhūrbhūretasya balādahāri bhavatā bhītā natārātinā| kiṃ nāmāparamatra kāryamadhunā sādhyaṃ samāśāsyate tatpāṇigrahamaṅgalāya manujādhīśāstu yatno mahān || " vikatthanādvicalanamāmananti budhā yathā| "kairavaḥ nanu tava nayahīne nāparādhaṃ smareyaṃ manasi visṛja bhītiṃ matkrudho nā'si pātram| bhuvanamakhilameko bhugnayaiva bhruvā'haṃ niyamayitumadhīśo nīrajākṣaprabhāvāt || " kāryasya saṅgraho yatsyāttadādānaṃ mataṃ yathā || 57 || "kairavaḥ (svagatam) astu nāmaitāṃ kuṭṭinīṃ devakulāgrasthāpitadīpasthambhopari nidhāya gamiṣyāmi" vyavasāyādānaśaktitrayamāvaśyakaṃ tviha| bījavanto mukhādyarthā viprakīrṇā yathāyatham || 58 || ekārthyamupanīyante yatra nirvahaṇaṃ hi tat| sandhirvirodho grathanaṃ nirṇayaḥ paribhāṣaṇam || 59 || prasādānandasamayā kṛtirbhāṣopagumbhane| pūrvabhāvopasaṃhārau praśastiśca caturdaśa || 60 || mukhasūcitabījārthaprāptiḥ sandhirmatā yathā| "kairavaḥ ādāvaghaṭitaṃ kāryaṃ madhye sughaṭitaṃ mama| bhūyo vighaṭitaṃ bhūyo bhūyāddhaṭayituṃ prabhuḥ || " mārgaṇaṃ tasya kāryasya virodhaḥ kathyate yathā || 61 || "saurabhaḥ sā tvayaivamavamānitā satī kuṭṭinī kupitapannagīnibhā| mārayetkimu mahīśatarjitā mānayetkimuta mandavigrahā || " grathanaṃ tasya kāryasya tūpakṣepo mato yathā| "kairavaḥ vayasya! nātra sandehaḥ| śāntimeti sakalo'pi bhūbhujāṃ sannidhau sahajavairitarjitaḥ| tāmasā api tarakṣavo mṛgaiḥ sañcaranti hi samaṃ tapovane || " anubhūtārthakathanaṃ nirṇayo'bhihito yathā || 62 || saurabhaḥ vayasya! maivaṃ mantavyam | sa devatāveśmani satyasaṅgaraḥ satāṃ samakṣaṃ samudīritaṃ tathā| vacaḥ svakīyaṃ vasudheśvaraḥ kathaṃ muhūrtamātreṇa mṛṣā kariṣyati || " anyonyaparivādo'yaṃ paribhāṣā'tra sā yathā| "makaradaṃṣṭrā (saroṣaṃ ) ale dubbahmaṇa!
